# Guild Leader
Guild Leaders shift objectives:
1) Ensure mercenaries are understanding in both their abilities and expectations in the sector. (You are not responsible for their actions)
2) Foster collaboration and coordinate efforts of mercenary teams where possible.
3) Encourage combat mentorship, either personally, time permitting, or by finding appropriate placement for interns.
4) Compensate medical teams for their work in assisting with the above three goals.
5) Collect rare and exotic firearms, trophies, or otherwise notable curios from expeditions, using the guilds ledger as you see fit.
## Your Ledger
To compensate medical teams and station staff you have been provided a discretionary fund.
Nanotrasen is prepared to provide additional resources for the successful completion of planet-side missions (Expeditions).
## Standard Operating Procedures
1) The Guild Leader is expected to uphold the maintenance of the Expeditionary Lodge as a primary responsibility, this pertains to general hygiene and habitability.
2) The Guild Leader is not expected to remain at the Expeditionary Lodge. You are encouraged to be present where needed and act in a capacity that best fulfills your primary goals.
3) The Guild Leader is permitted to engage in expeditions as they see fit, however are advised to only do so as the primary leader of a team of at least 3 total members including themselves.
4) The Guild Leader is not to permit their voucher purchased expedition capable shuttle to be used by other teams without their presence.
5) The Guild Leader must not seek to engage in conflicts with freelancers unless directly involved as a primary party.
6) The Guild Leader is not permitted to issue credits to crews for completing expeditions outside of hiring crew for their own conducted expeditions.
